title: Elon Musk takes the stand in high-profile trial against OpenAI
brief: Elon Musk began testimony in his lawsuit against OpenAI CEO Sam Altman and president Greg Brockman, alleging the co-founders departed from the organization's nonprofit mission after Musk invested up to $38 million. The dispute centers on governance disagreements and Musk's subsequent founding of xAI as a competitor.
